1.0.3.title: Uma experiência desktop mais prática e ágil.
1.0.3.summary: Esta versão aprimora a navegação e as configurações, salva a preferência de volume e reaproveita listas de episódios para reduzir consultas repetidas.

highlights.title: Navegação integrada à janela
highlights.description: Use voltar e avançar na barra superior e retome a última página visitada.

highlights.title: Configurações reorganizadas
highlights.description: As opções estão agrupadas em seções para facilitar o acesso.

highlights.title: Volume salvo localmente
highlights.description: O nível de volume do player é mantido entre as sessões.

highlights.title: Listas de episódios em cache
highlights.description: Listas recentes podem ser reutilizadas para agilizar a abertura de episódios.

githubRelease.summary: Animonkey 1.0.3 refines desktop navigation and Settings, remembers player volume locally, caches Anivexa episode lists, and makes the update center easier to scan.

sections.title: Window navigation
details: Windows now uses the custom application title bar with in-app back and forward controls. The app also restores the last successfully visited internal route at startup, while explicit anime deep links take precedence ([custom window chrome](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/commit/ff6bc97), [route restoration](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/commit/45ffd94), [back and forward controls](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/commit/09359c9)).

sections.title: Settings experience
details: Settings is organized into sections for account and sync, Anivexa diagnostics, and local backup. The unavailable caption settings entry is hidden until the app supports configurable caption preferences ([Settings redesign](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/commit/fc60ecb), [caption settings adjustment](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/commit/d099019)).

sections.title: Playback preferences and episode cache
details: Player volume is stored through the existing IndexedDB-backed local preference store and restored across app sessions ([volume preference](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/commit/025ec1b)).

Anivexa episode lists are persisted client-side in the existing IndexedDB catalog cache. Expiry follows AniList airing data: after an expected episode time, missing episodes are retried hourly; once the episode appears, the cache follows the next weekly slot. Completed lists are retained for 30 days, and a failed refresh serves the previous list and retries after an hour ([episode-list cache](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/commit/6b06346)).

sections.title: Application update center
details: The update center opens on a compact version overview, identifies the installed version, and lets users select a release to read its concise app-facing notes. Existing update detection and install behavior remain in place ([update-center redesign](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/commit/80f94ae), [version overview](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/commit/b6f19f8)).

1.0.2.title: Aprimoramentos de diagnóstico e confiabilidade.
1.0.2.summary: Esta atualização reúne melhorias no tratamento das mensagens de diagnóstico do runtime da API Anivexa e ajustes técnicos nos fluxos internos da aplicação.

highlights.title: Diagnósticos do runtime Anivexa
highlights.description: Mensagens técnicas passaram a ser tratadas de forma mais controlada e concisa.

highlights.title: Aprimoramentos internos
highlights.description: A versão inclui ajustes técnicos nos fluxos internos relacionados à conta.

githubRelease.summary: Patch release focused on Anivexa runtime diagnostics, account-sync IPC validation, and a more verifiable Windows release process.

sections.title: Anivexa runtime diagnostics
details: Sanitized API error summaries continue through the diagnostics channel, while stderr receives a fixed redacted message instead of the original `console.error` arguments ([commit `13702a0`](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/commit/13702a0)).

sections.title: Account synchronization IPC
details: Watch-later upserts validate anime IDs, title shape, optional fields, episode counts, release dates, genres, and timestamps before reaching the account service.

Episode-progress upserts validate identifiers, non-negative episode numbers, finite time values, positive durations, and that current playback time does not exceed duration. Both validation paths were added in [commit `c5bf1de`](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/commit/c5bf1de).

sections.title: Windows packaging and release workflow
details: The application root MIT license is included as a packaged resource ([commit `502665a`](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/commit/502665a)).

The Windows package verifier checks the Setup installer, full Squirrel `.nupkg`, executable identity, required Anivexa runtime files and revision, package manifest, and `RELEASES` hash and size ([commit `591c1f4`](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/commit/591c1f4)).

Development CI runs Linux quality checks in one job and builds the Windows package only for a `dev`-to-`main` promotion pull request. The manual stable-release workflow builds the exact tag and creates a draft with the installer, full `.nupkg`, and `RELEASES` already attached. The release-pipeline redesign was integrated by [PR #1](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/pull/1) and promoted with [PR #2](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/pull/2). The split between concise app notes and detailed GitHub notes is tracked by [PR #3](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/pull/3) and its promotion in [PR #4](https://github.com/DaniHRE/animonkey-electron/pull/4).

1.0.1.title: O Animonkey recebe atualizações pelo próprio app.
1.0.1.summary: A primeira atualização para quem já usa a 1.0.0 traz o ícone aprovado para o aplicativo e o setup, além de avisos para acompanhar novas versões, downloads e reinicialização.

highlights.title: Atualizações pelo aplicativo
highlights.description: Veja quando uma nova versão está disponível, acompanhe o download e escolha quando reiniciar.

highlights.title: Ícone alinhado no Windows
highlights.description: O ícone aprovado identifica o aplicativo instalado, as janelas e o setup.

highlights.title: Novidades por versão
highlights.description: Consulte o que mudou após cada atualização e reabra as notas pelo centro de atualizações.

1.0.0.title: Anime para descobrir e acompanhar.
1.0.0.summary: O Animonkey chega ao desktop com uma experiência feita para explorar animes, organizar sua biblioteca e continuar de onde parou.

highlights.title: Explore o catálogo
highlights.description: Encontre títulos, veja detalhes e acompanhe a agenda com dados do AniList.

highlights.title: Sua biblioteca, no seu dispositivo
highlights.description: Salve progresso, avaliações e listas localmente. Os dados continuam disponíveis offline.

highlights.title: Sincronização opcional
highlights.description: Entre na sua conta quando quiser sincronizar os dados compatíveis entre dispositivos.

highlights.title: Assista a episódios disponíveis
highlights.description: Consulte fontes da Anivexa e reproduza os streams compatíveis com o player.
